title: GWAS SNPs
bodyHtml: This genetic variant class is composed of common single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) associated with autism via genome-wide association studies (GWAS). Most GWAS SNPs are located in non-coding regions of the genome, so all SNPs have been mapped to their most likely target gene using the omnibus SNP-to-gene linkage method Consensus SNP2Gene (Gazal et al., 2022). GWAS SNPs were originally obtained from GWAS Catalog (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gwas/).
